chapter: Race, critics and the big bands
title: Meeting every band at the bus as a kid in Florida
summary: Sam says he met all the bands as a kid, so he knew everyone when he reached New York, including Oscar Pettiford.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: You mentioned before like the Lucky Millinder's band.
Yeah I met all bands. In fact I was standing
And that's how when I got to New York, I knew everybody. Because as a kid, I met all those dudes, when the door opened, when they stepped off the bus, there I was right there to greet them.

I would go down to the hotel and walk in there and ask them, ask the people at the desk what time the band was coming and they would always tell me. So I would stand outside just patiently me and my boys. Sit out there and wait, man.
That's how much, how interested I was in music. I met Oscar Pettiford, man, right there in Florida.
